name: M7.StreamingCost.cursor_bound
statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin n → M7.StreamingCost.Eval) (i fuel a b : ℕ), (∀ j, (p j).outer ≤ a ∧ (p j).inner ≤ b) → (M7.StreamingCost.allFinFrom n p i fuel).outer ≤ fuel*a ∧ (M7.StreamingCost.allFinFrom n p i fuel).inner ≤ fuel*b
guidance: Induct fuel generalizing i; zero/out-of-range cost is zero. True branch adds the actual current two charges to induction bounds, false branch returns only current charges. omega/nlinarith or Nat arithmetic. No abstract evaluator cost is asserted; these are explicit counters. Return tactic lines only; no leading by.
